title: trainOrderInputs
description: A train order face (FieldUnit ADR 0010 D1, D2): its inputs ranked from the most restrictive, each with the indication it shows, and the rest word nothing asserted shows. Rows keyed by rulebook, with default; the layout's Rulebook selects the row (ADR 0012 §6).

table.description: The table's name, the file's stem; provenance.referenceData of a layout file names it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the file is written to. 0 until the KiCad importer and FieldUnit work end to end; no bump rules before then (the owner, 2026-11-13).

version.description: The table's provenance date, with .n when it was revised again that day. A layout file names it in provenance.referenceData.<table>.version.

provenance.description: Where the rows come from: the owner's ruling, the document and date, or the standard opened.

inputs.description: Ranked: the first asserted in this order wins.

indication.description: An indication word of the FieldUnit vocabulary (docs/GLOSSARY.md), or DARK.

rest.description: An indication word of the FieldUnit vocabulary (docs/GLOSSARY.md), or DARK.

rows.description: Keyed by rulebook (the layout's given.Rulebook) or default.
